results.clippy: model, session, automation and Martensite adapter all targets passed

scope: Rust semantic face names are validated and stored in versioned work-plane recipes, with the producer feature included in dependency tracking.

A real named Martensite prism supports a face-offset datum through 10/20 mm size edit, undo, redo and Rust recipe reopen. A separate session test uses a named fake to check result invalidation and replay.
Missing, failed, consumed, foreign and wrong-kind references are refused locally; independent feature evaluation continues.
limits: The test uses a Rust semantic name derived from a Go witness; it does not migrate a Go face key or adopt the Go dependent-plane package.
The in-plane basis differs between Go and Martensite. A public creation path must verify name binding on write and preserve legacy sketch coordinates.
No native UI command or full gate was verified.
